# MetaViewer
Rust authority; Electron/Vue renders admitted snapshots and submits intents.
Read first: AGENTS.md, then catalogue/protocol.json.
Route: python3 router/kit/tools/route_v2.py --q "<task>" --index catalogue/router --params catalogue/router/params.json
No shell: catalogue/subjects.json -> subjects/<sid>/index.json -> one page -> catalogue/routes.tsv -> anchor.
Status: router unavailable.
